comments.text: The fear that the Amazon tribes have of contracting it reminds me of a traveler named Nico from the channel Ride Me Five. He's a guy traveling across all 5 continents through the most isolated places on a motorcycle. When he was traveling through Africa, in places like the deep Namibian desert, the people from Stone Age villages or nomadic tribes would run away from him on sight. They thought he was a ghost or a monster. He asked around and learned that oral stories say the white man is dangerous and you should run away because he's going to kidnap you. Those stories originated during colonization and the Victorian slave trade. And 200 years later, it's amazing how, even though these stories are only oral, they're still alive.
